title: Opportunistic insider cluster purchases: two or more officers or directors buy within 21 sessions
references: Seyhun (1986), Insiders' Profits, Costs of Trading, and Market Efficiency, Journal of Financial Economics
Lakonishok and Lee (2001), Are Insider Trades Informative?, Review of Financial Studies
Jeng, Metrick and Zeckhauser (2003), Estimating the Returns to Insider Trading, Review of Economics and Statistics
Cohen, Malloy and Pomorski (2012), Decoding Inside Information, Journal of Finance
Alldredge and Blank (2019), Do Insiders Cluster Trades with Colleagues?, Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
hypotheses: LONG only, over decisions 2016-08-01..2026-07-31 on cohort v3 (config/research/pooled/cohort-v3.json, the 1,000-name liquidity band) with the bracket, eligibility and 15 bp decisive cost of the cached cohort-v3 label cube (10:35 New York decision, 2 x ATR14 stop, 3R target, 20-session time exit): an event fires on an SEC Form 4 filing date F when at least two distinct officers or directors have opportunistic open-market purchases of the issuer filed within the 21 sessions ending at F (a purchase is routine, and ignored, when the same owner filed a purchase of the same issuer in the same calendar month of the previous year; implausible trades above 10 x the 20-session median raw dollar volume are dropped first), at most once per name per 63 sessions; the trade is the cube cell on D, the first session strictly after F. Control = the mean of the 5 cube cells on the same session D in the event's dollar-volume tercile, with at least one qualifying Form 4 transaction (purchase or sale) filed before D but without any qualifying purchase filed in the 126 sessions before D, and not themselves events, nearest in 20-session return to D-1. P1: mean R_cost > 0 with the bootstrap ci90 lower bound > 0. P2: mean R_cost(leg) - mean R_cost(control) > 0 with the paired ci90 lower bound > 0, pairs keyed by D. P3: the 1%-trimmed mean > 0 and the mean over decisions from 2023-01-01 > 0. P4: at least 300 labelled events, at least 100 from 2023-01-01. Stationary session-block bootstrap over decision sessions, block mean 10, 2000 draws, seed 20261023; ci90 = [5th, 95th] percentiles. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-apriori-insider-leg-design.md.
decision_rule: The leg becomes eligible for a capped live paper probe (its own spec) only if P1, P2, P3 and P4 all hold; otherwise it stays off and is recorded as failed. No threshold, window, buyer count, cluster window, cooldown or control parameter is revisited after the run; any change is a new version with a new, non-overlapping window. The 60-session hold and every split are descriptive diagnostics and decide nothing. Running this leg reads insider-conditioned outcomes over the pooled lane's confirmation slice, so the pooled insider fixed sets stay retired.
